title: What If a Giraffe Moved Into Your Living Room? #shorts

lines.text: A giraffe just moved into your living room, and his head is already through the ceiling!
He's up to eighteen feet tall, and your ceiling was not built for that.
His tongue is eighteen inches long and purple, so your cereal never stood a chance.
He eats seventy five pounds a day, so your houseplants are now a memory.
And he sleeps about thirty minutes a day, so he is definitely taking your couch.
Moral: never invite a giraffe over.

sources: https://animals.sandiegozoo.org/node/66 (males up to 18 ft / 5.5 m; tongue about 18 in / 46 cm and dark, thought to prevent sunburn; seven neck vertebrae; sleeps only about 5 to 30 minutes a day; eats up to 75 lb / 34 kg a day)
https://www.discoverwildlife.com/animal-facts/mammals/giraffe-facts (4-5 m typical height; tongue 45-50 cm, bluish-purple; heart about 11 kg)

facts.hedge: living room scenario is a comedic what-if
